name: Devil's Eyes
source:
Mike arrives at university and is ready to have a time of his life, but something is not quite right. Follow the story and unveil the mysteries behind the tragic events.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
迈克来到大学，准备尽情享受人生中最美好的时光，但似乎有什么地方不太对劲。跟随故事，揭开一连串悲剧背后的谜团。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840120/]Steam[/url]]
